faq_heading: Homes near Star of the Sea: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Star of the Sea get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Star of the Sea is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Star of the Sea home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Star of the Sea. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.

Star of the Sea is an independent school in Surrey, at 15024 24 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Star of the Sea, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Star of the Sea search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Star of the Sea, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away.
